fields.// override-sortable-facetable: key field: Azure forbids sortable/facetable on the key
fields.name: id

fields.// searchable=true: long-form content text used for full-text query; sortable/facetable=false: long-text fields cannot be sort/facet keys
fields.name: content

fields.// vector-field: 3072-dim HNSW cosine; retrievable=false (vector payload is heavy, excluded from $select); stored=true retains for reranking; searchable=true enables vector search
fields.name: contentVector

fields.// searchable=true: text-content field (vendor display name) used for full-text query; sortable/facetable=true per policy
fields.name: vendorName

fields.// searchable=true: invoice number text searched in semantic queries; sortable/facetable=true per policy
fields.name: invoiceNumber

fields.// override-facetable: datetime faceting is rarely useful (per catalog policy table)
fields.name: invoiceDate

fields.// override-facetable: Edm.Double totalAmount is a continuous numeric (high cardinality) — faceting not useful
fields.name: totalAmount

fields.// override-facetable: datetime faceting is rarely useful (per catalog policy table)
fields.name: indexedAt

fields.// ebilling-r1 task 152 (FR-43, D-44): fields below are built from the invoice's structured records. All are ADDITIVE: no existing field's attributes change, so the deployer's PUT updates the live index in place (no recreate). The firm is vendorOrgId / vendorName (the invoice's sprk_vendororg); the billed total is totalAmount.
fields.name: coreRecordType

fields.// core record id: the id of the invoice's core record (matter, project or work assignment); matterId / projectId stay filled for those two types
fields.name: coreRecordId

fields.// searchable=true: core record display name is text content (full-text query); sortable/facetable=true per policy
fields.name: coreRecordName

fields.// collection: roster timekeeper ids of the invoice's fee lines; Azure forbids sortable on a collection
fields.name: timekeeperIds

fields.// searchable=true: timekeeper display names are text content; collection, so sortable=false
fields.name: timekeeperNames

fields.// collection: UTBMS task codes of the invoice's lines (the line's resolved code, else the code as billed)
fields.name: taskCodes

fields.// collection: UTBMS activity codes of the invoice's lines
fields.name: activityCodes

fields.// collection: UTBMS expense codes of the invoice's lines
fields.name: expenseCodes

fields.// searchable=true: tracking number {firm invoice number}.{n} (D-87) is searched as text, like invoiceNumber; sortable/facetable=true per policy
fields.name: trackingNumber

fields.// override-facetable: datetime faceting is rarely useful (per catalog policy table)
fields.name: billingPeriodStart

fields.// override-facetable: datetime faceting is rarely useful (per catalog policy table)
fields.name: billingPeriodEnd

fields.// override-facetable: Edm.Double approvedTotal is a continuous numeric (high cardinality) — faceting not useful; same as totalAmount (the billed total)
fields.name: approvedTotal

fields.// statusCode: sprk_invoice statuscode (FR-06 / D-41); the number, so a filter does not depend on the label
fields.name: statusCode

fields.// status: the lifecycle status name (InReview, Approved, SentToAp, Paid, Rejected, ReturnedToFirm, Cancelled)
fields.name: status
